title: eBay reveals the collectibles that defined 2026
summary: From World Cup and Knicks fever to Pokémon trading cards, the annual report reveals the trends and moments that shaped collecting culture this year.
body_markdown:
**SAN JOSE, Calif., November 17, 2026** — Today, eBay, the global destination for must-have collectibles, released the 2026 edition of eBay Collected, its annual report highlighting the athletes, fandoms, and pop culture moments that captivated collectors worldwide.


Powered by eBay marketplace data and innovation, the report also includes highlights from TCGplayer, an eBay company focused on trading card games, and Goldin, an eBay company specializing in rare and high value collectibles.


Pokémon was the top-searched term in eBay’s collectibles category* — no surprise as the global phenomenon celebrates its 30th anniversary year, but the highest value trading card sale of all time — the $16.492 million Pokémon Pikachu Illustrator sale made by Goldin — made headlines around the world and kicked off a year of incredible sales in 2026.


In the sports world, the New York Knicks' historic championship and World Cup fever drove massive search spikes, spotlighting Jalen Brunson and Jude Bellingham among the biggest sports stars in the world. Meanwhile, notable shifts in popular toys and trading card games — namely, soaring demand for NeeDoh sensory toys versus last year’s chase for Labubu dolls, and the One Piece trading card game overtaking longtime favorite, Yu-Gi-Oh! at TCGplayer — demonstrated collector appetite for fresh entertainment and diversity in sought-after collectibles.


The report also spotlights some of 2026’s most exciting moments on eBay Live, eBay’s interactive livestream shopping experience. eBay Live became a more significant part of the eBay shopping experience in 2026, bringing together more enthusiasts, expert sellers and fandoms to discover, connect and shop in real time. Notable athlete appearances include NFL legend Rob Gronkowski and soccer stars Jack Wilshere and Landon Donovan, and celebrity guests including Sean Astin, Billy Boyd and Dominic Monaghan of The Lord of the Rings fame, with many others.


“What makes collecting special is the passion behind it, and each year, our eBay Collected report celebrates that passion and the incredible diversity of the category,” said Adam Ireland, VP and General Manager, Global Collectibles, eBay. “Whether it’s the latest Riftbound set or a Spider-Man comic, we want to connect collectors with what they love. From eBay Live and card scanning to expanding Authenticity Guarantee and bringing more comprehensive data to our price guide, we’re making it easier than ever to discover, buy and sell on eBay.”


Explore all the trends at[ebay.com/collected](http://ebay.com/collected) , and shop the hottest collectibles of the year in a special series of eBay Live streams hosted by top sellers XP Collect, Card Vault, Cajun Cardboard, and more at the[eBay Collected Edit channel](https://www.ebay.com/ebaylive/channels/sEsG3v54sf7idnFK) . Ahead of the holiday season, collectors can also explore a curation of the[most in-demand toys](https://www.ebay.com/e/hottest-toys) on eBay.com.


### 2026: Year in Review


**Basketball stars ruled the search bar**


-


Knicks Mania swept 2026, with searches for NBA Finals MVP Jalen Brunson topping 90x per minute following his championship performance.


-


Basketball stars claimed half of eBay’s top 10 most-searched athlete rankings, with Michael Jordan holding onto No. 1 and rising star Cooper Flagg making his debut on the list.


**Global tournaments skyrocketed athlete searches**


-


Following the World Cup, searches for Jude Bellingham and Erling Haaland jumped +350% and +190%, respectively on eBay.com in July compared with June.


-


On the days they won Olympic gold medals, the number of Jack Hughes items sold increased globally by more than 6,000%, while searches for ski jumper Philipp Raimund in Germany increased more than 8,684%.


**Pokémon’s 30th anniversary fueled mega demand**


-


With the release of the new Pokémon Mega Evolutions expansion and Elite Trainer boxes, searches for Mega Gengar ex jumped 390% globally in February compared with January.


-


A rare Pikachu Illustrator card sold by Logan Paul for $16.492 million through Goldin, setting a new auction record for the highest-value trading card ever sold.


**Viral sensations became valuable collectibles**


-


Colorful stress toys became 2026’s most unexpected collectible sensation with the number of NeeDoh items sold on eBay globally increasing more than 9400% from January to September 2025 compared to the same period in 2026.


-


Global searches increased more than 75% for Fuggler Dolls year-over-year, while searches for Trader Joe’s Totes jumped more than 350% in September compared with August 2026.


-


Global searches for LEGO Pokémon surged more than 1000% worldwide, in January 2026 compared with December 2025.


**Historic coins found a new generation of collectors**


-


Pieces of the past were in high demand this year, as global listings of historic coins rose +44% in June 2026 compared with June 2025.


-


Global searches for rare coins also increased over the same period, including the Brasher Doubloon (+127%) and EID MAR Denarius (+113%).


*Based on global[eBay.com](http://ebay.com/) search data from January - September 2026.
